channel.title: Fierce Network
channel.description: a feed of the latest articles on our website

title.a: After Qualcomm, who else might get a piece of Starlink Mobile’s 5G network?

item.description: Qualcomm will power Starlink Mobile's 5G macro sites, but analysts say SpaceX may skip the usual RAN vendors.

title.a: AWS wants to put AI agents on a Layer 7 leash

item.description: Networks were built to trust humans. AWS VP Rob Kennedy says that won't work for AI agents that treat restrictions as obstacles.

title.a: Starlink’s US broadband users are moving beyond rural America: Ookla

item.description: Urban users grew faster than rural users in every state but Alaska and Hawaii in the first half of 2026 according to a new Ookla Speedtest report.
